race.comment: GOSPEL GIRL (10) burst through to get the verdict second-up at Ipswich after an encouraging fresh effort at Doomben. Has more to offer third-up and keeps Youngberry's 3kg claim over a trip the mare relishes. Big chance to make it two on the bounce. SURPRISE HONEY (6) has put two on the bounce in impressive fashion and gets a great chance to bring up the hat-trick. Drawn stickier this time and has more weight to carry but can still get the job done. FABULANTES (3) didn't fire a shot in the G3 Fred Best Classic before spelling but his work prior reads favourably. Is drawn cosy over a favoured track and trip and strips fitter for a recent trial. In this up to his ears. HELL (1) will bounce straight to the front from a good draw and look to steal it. If he gets his own way through the middle he will prove hard to run down.
